card.title: One Suspicious Detail
card.instruction: Choose one ordinary detail and treat it as the clue that will expose the entire hidden story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The painting's gone. That red thread on its frame will explain everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My scarf caught there last night. Can we open the gallery?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This thread will date the theft. Was the painting there then?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. But I picked that thread off before leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this one means someone came back wearing your scarf. Keep it on; we'll reconstruct the whole night from this snag.

mechanism: A gives the red thread decisive authority over reconstructing the missing painting, even as B changes what it can prove.
confusable: Unlike testing several theories against all clues, A insists that this one ordinary thread will reveal the entire story.
comparison: The protected alternative uses a coffee ring despite the keys being found; this one uses a replaced thread to infer a return visit. Protected S143-b is context only.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
